Rashi (Moon Sign) Calculator
Your Vedic Moon sign, from your date and approximate time of birth.
Approximate: the Moon changes sign roughly every 2¼ days, so this uses a simplified lunar-position formula (not a full ephemeris). If your birth time is near a sign change, confirm with an astrologer.

What your Rashi is

Your Rashi is the zodiac sign the Moon occupied when you were born, measured in the sidereal zodiac that Vedic astrology uses. In India it is the sign most people mean when they talk about their sign, and it is the one used for the daily rashifal.

The Moon moves quickly, changing sign roughly every two and a quarter days, so your birth time helps decide which sign it was in.

How accurate the result is

The calculator uses a simplified formula for the Moon's position rather than a full astronomical ephemeris. For most births that is enough to give the right sign. If you were born close to the time the Moon changed sign, the result may be one sign out, and an astrologer can confirm it from your exact birth details.

Frequently asked

Common questions

What is the difference between Rashi and sun sign?

Your Rashi is based on the Moon in the sidereal zodiac. Your sun sign is based on the Sun, usually in the Western tropical zodiac. They are often different signs.

What if I do not know my birth time?

Leave it at 12:00. On most days the Moon stays in one sign for the whole day, so the result is often still right, but treat it as likely rather than certain.

Is the Rashi used to choose a name?

Yes. In many families the first syllable of a baby's name is chosen from the birth Nakshatra, which also fixes the Rashi.
